subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and carry this new bundled Wear OS companion app, including its direct gateway auth, phone-proxy, CI, release, and security-review surface?
rationale: The remaining blockers are fixable, but the PR adds a large new native app surface and the contributor has explicitly stepped back, so automation cannot decide whether maintainers want to own the product and release boundary.

options.title: Adopt and repair
options.body: A maintainer takes ownership, rebases the branch, fixes the backup/auth/CI blockers, adds stronger proof, and decides the release path.

options.title: Defer the Wear app
options.body: Close or pause this PR until a maintainer-sponsored Wear OS direction and owner are available.

recommendation.title: Adopt and repair
recommendation.body: A maintainer takes ownership, rebases the branch, fixes the backup/auth/CI blockers, adds stronger proof, and decides the release path.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has already touched the branch's Wear gateway config path, making them the best available owner for the adoption decision.
